name: Gupta 2025 erenumab immune-tolerance scenarios
description: Exact source anchors plus full ODE study-design simulations with paper ADA-incidence endpoint overlays.

scenarios.name: Exact article/SI table replay
scenarios.description: No-dose exact replay of the PK parameter table, immune parameter table, sensitivity table, supplement Table S1 constants, and text-reported study endpoints.

scenarios.name: Group 1.1 monomer without immunosuppression
scenarios.description: Full ODE simulation of the paper study design. Erenumab boluses enter the SC depot; MTX/TAC concentrations use the supplement multiple-extravascular-dose equations. Paper comparator is reported ADA incidence/threshold because public per-animal source trajectories are unavailable.
